text: Tayar Nepal supports the National Disaster and Risk Reduction Management Agency (NDRRMA) to become fully functional, advances national disaster simulations and response technologies, and establishes a National Disaster Training Academy. It also builds municipal capacity for risk-informed planning and implements community-based adaptation and risk mitigation measures. The project includes private-sector partnerships to foster resilience among women-led businesses and deploys digital tools like the 'Ma Ta Chhu Tayar' app for risk management.
